name: github-manager-skills
description: Claude Code skills for engineering managers that compute from exported GitHub data: a stuck-PR and review-queue digest, an iteration report and an incident postmortem timeline, every number cited to the PR or issue it came from.

plugins.name: github-manager
plugins.description: Three skills, each with a tested standard-library script over saved gh exports: pr-queue-digest, iteration-report and incident-postmortem-timeline. Team level only, no per-person scoring.
